description: 128-cell linear-grid pair-copula estimator, fine-tuned for 8,000 steps from a 60,000-step pilot trained from scratch on corrected synthetic data. Evaluated only in the NeurIPS 2026 paper's appendix on exploratory retraining. Inputs use latent uniforms with probability 0.75 and rank pseudo-observations otherwise.
selection_rule: configuration and training seed fixed before the appendix evaluations (first fine-tuning seed)

inference.precision: float32 network with TF32 disabled; float64 copula projection
inference.vine: VineCopulaModel.from_pretrained: batched D-vine with greedy |tau| order

training.objective: negative log likelihood of independent target points under the projected bilinear density
training.device: one NVIDIA H100 80GB (fine-tuning); one NVIDIA H200 (pilot)

evaluation.table1_cases: nine bivariate cases x five seeds, n_train=2000, 20,000 test points per fit

intended_use: bivariate copula density estimation with consistent conditional distributions
vine copula fitting, likelihood, Rosenblatt transforms and sampling
reproducing the NeurIPS 2026 appendix on exploratory retraining
limitations: exploratory estimator trained after the NeurIPS 2026 review; the paper's main results use vdc-denoiser-m64-v1
model development also used copula families from the paper's out-of-distribution suite, so it has no clean out-of-distribution evaluation
the random S&P100 split overlaps model-development data (272 of 339 test days); only the chronological split is held out
one pilot initialization and one fine-tuning seed; replicates changed the chronological S&P100 comparison
continuous marginals and the simplifying assumption for vine copulas
floating-point identity is established for the recorded device types and software versions only
